name: Maasai Mara
blurb: Online discussions about the Maasai Mara focus heavily on wildlife viewings, particularly the Great Migration and river crossings. Visitors frequently share photography of big cats, elephants, giraffes, and regional landscapes.

positive: Thrilling wildlife migration and river crossing viewings
Spectacular sunrise and sunset landscape photography
Memorable sightings of big cats and elephants
negative: Reservations that certain areas can feel busy

Why You Need to Witness the Great Wildebeest Migration in Maasai Mara 

Imagine 1.5 million wildebeest (plus hundreds of thousands of zebras) thundering across the endless plains in a living river of hooves and dust.

Or...Samburu and you can climb Mt Kenya on the way... The lakes Naivasha, Nakuru,Baringo? Everywhere you look, it's stunning! Masai mara... busy. Amboseli busy but Garden of eden level of animals 😉. Or..chimps in Uganda?.. oohh. I'm jealous! Have fun deciding on your destination
